answer: Before first payout, the holder reads a one-time code from a spiral notebook in a whisper on an island radio station, which keeps a signed broadcast log. Two verifiers match the log and recording against the station's archive within a week; a broadcast claimed twice, or no station on record, closes both. A broadcast slot costs 2.5 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand broadcasts and 2.5 billion.
